03What It IsOVERVIEW▶

A Claude skill that collects the complete Reviews & Ratings tab of a MakerWorld model: star ratings, comments, and every reply under them, however deep. Non-English posts are translated, and each entry gets a permalink that opens the model page with that thread pinned at the top.

The result is one JSON file (plus an optional plain-text thread tree). After delivering it, Claude offers a button to build Swami's vibe dashboard from the same file, with stats, a Q&A synthesis, critical feedback, every thread, the designer's replies, a search, a mind map, a glossary, and an audio overview.

Why it mattersMakerWorld loads reviews by script, 10 at a time, with replies hidden behind "View N more replies". WebFetch only sees an empty page and Claude's cloud workspace can't reach makerworld.com at all, so the data has to come from the site's own API, called from inside a real browser tab.
04What It DoesOVERVIEW▶
  • Full extractionPages through every top-level rating and comment, then every reply thread, from inside the model page's browser tab. It only reads; it never posts, likes, or replies.
  • Background pullRuns the extraction in the background and checks on it every 35 seconds, because each browser script call times out after about 45 seconds.
  • Count checkCompares what it got with the page's own Reviews & Ratings (N) count, and reports any small reply gap left by deleted replies.
  • TranslationTranslates every non-English post into English and keeps the original text beside it, with short [bracketed] clarifications only where needed.
  • Threaded JSONWrites <model-slug>_makerworld_reviews.json: a nested reply tree with dotted ids (12, 12.3, 12.3.1), plus a flat list of the same entries.
  • PermalinksGives every entry a link using MakerWorld's own replyId / replyType format, which opens the page at that thread (verified working Oct 2026).
  • Plain textAlso writes threaded.txt, the whole thread tree in the original languages, delivered as the main output when Swami asks for "just the text".
  • DashboardOn request, or from the button after delivery, builds a vibe dashboard from the JSON in the current vibe-dashboard format: stats (including ratings by print profile), common questions, critical feedback, rating and comment threads, designer replies, and contributors, plus the Search section, Mind Map, Glossary, References, and an audio overview.

08Capabilities and LimitationsSCOPE▶
  • Complete threadsGets every rating, comment, and reply, including the ones hidden behind "View N more replies", in one run.
  • No sign-inReviews are public, so it normally works without a MakerWorld account.
  • Read-onlyNever posts, rates, likes, replies, boosts, downloads, or follows on Swami's behalf.
  • Many languagesTranslates Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, and any other language, keeping the original text.
  • Deep linksEvery entry links straight to its thread on MakerWorld.
  • Reusable JSONA dashboard can be built later from a JSON this skill made, with no new extraction.
  • Needs a browserExtraction needs a real browser tab: the desktop app's built-in pane, Claude in Chrome, or Comet. WebFetch and the cloud workspace can't reach makerworld.com.
  • One modelOne model page per run.
  • Reply gapReply counts can come out a little lower than the site's, because the site still counts deleted replies.
  • No imagesImage-only posts come through with empty text; photos are not downloaded.
  • Site changesIt relies on MakerWorld's own web API, which the site can change without notice.
  • Machine translationTranslations are Claude's own, with bracketed clarifications; the original text is kept beside each one.
  • Not yet runThe current version hasn't been run end to end in any browser yet; an earlier version worked in Comet.
09Scheduled TasksRUNTIME▶

None. The skill runs only when asked and neither needs nor creates a scheduled task. The nightly "Skills dashboard nightly refresh" repackages its zip for GitHub but never runs it.

11GotchasGOTCHAS▶
  • Empty pageWebFetch returns an empty shell and the cloud workspace's proxy refuses makerworld.com, so don't try to fetch the page; use the browser.
  • Script timeoutBrowser script calls stop after about 45 seconds. The pull runs in the background and Claude polls it; a long model just takes more polls.
  • Blocked resultsScript results holding URL query strings or long encoded data come back as [BLOCKED: …]. The fix is built in: each chunk is written into the page as text and read back with get_page_text.
  • Sign-inIf the API calls fail with 401 or 403 or return nothing, sign in to MakerWorld yourself in that browser. Claude never types credentials or solves CAPTCHAs.
  • Fetch failureA fetch error is retried once after a minute. If it fails again, sign in or reload the page.
  • Reply gapA few missing replies are normal (deleted ones still count on the site). Claude reports the gap in one line and doesn't chase it.
  • Wrong browserUse the desktop app's pane, real Chrome, or Perplexity's Comet. Edge and other Chromium browsers are not supported.
  • Hidden offerThe dashboard offer comes as a button, sent last, because a file card can push a text offer out of view.
  • Project threadsWhere the file, message, or button tools aren't available (a project thread or another surface), Claude attaches the files that surface's own way and sends the summary and the dashboard offer as plain messages.
  • Translation typosbuild_reviews.py refuses translation ids it doesn't know, so a mistyped id shows up at once instead of silently dropping a translation.
  • Crushed columnsDashboard thread tables use exactly three columns (From, Review, Link); splitting out author, stars, and date makes names break one letter per line.
  • Personal detailsEmails or phone numbers in reviews are kept as written. Claude mentions them and asks before putting them on a dashboard meant for public sharing.
  • First runThe current version hasn't been run end to end yet in any browser (an earlier version worked in Comet). Treat the first run as a test and check the counts against the page.
12Other RequirementsREFERENCE▶
  • A computerA Mac, or a Windows 10 or 11 PC, with the Claude desktop app or Google Chrome with the Claude in Chrome extension.
  • Code executionClaude's code execution ("Create and edit files") must be on to build the JSON and the dashboard.
  • Site accessThe browser must be allowed to open makerworld.com; Claude asks for it the first time.
  • MakerWorld accountOnly needed if the site refuses Claude's requests; then sign in yourself in that browser.
  • DashboardsThe vibe-dashboard skill must be installed to build a reviews dashboard.

MakerWorldSitesBambu Lab's website for sharing 3D print models, where each model page has a Reviews & Ratings tab.
Reviews & RatingsSitesThe model page's tab holding star ratings, comments, and their replies; its count includes all three.
Print profileSitesA saved set of slicer settings attached to a MakerWorld model; each rating records which profile the reviewer printed with.
Built-in browserBrowsersThe browser pane inside the Claude desktop app, which Claude can drive; the preferred place to run the extraction.

CometBrowsersPerplexity's AI browser; supported, and the browser an earlier version of this skill ran in.
WebFetchBrowsersClaude's tool for reading a web page as text; it only sees an empty shell on MakerWorld, because the reviews load by script.
javascript_toolExtractionThe browser tool that runs JavaScript in the open tab; the extraction runs through it and each call stops after about 45 seconds.
get_page_textExtractionThe browser tool that reads a page's text; used to copy each data chunk out of the tab.
Background pullExtractionThe extraction script left running in the tab while Claude checks its progress every 35 seconds.
ChunkExtractionA piece of the extracted data, about 18,000 characters of JSON Lines, copied out of the tab one at a time.
APIExtractionMakerWorld's own web interface that returns reviews and replies as data; the skill calls it from inside the model page.
build_reviews.pyOutputThe Python script the skill saves and runs in Claude's workspace to thread, translate, and write the output files.
translations.jsonOutputThe file of English translations by entry id that the second build pass folds into the JSON.
Threaded JSONOutputThe main output: every entry nested under its parent, with counts, notes, source details, and a flat list of the same entries.
threaded.txtOutputA plain-text version of the whole thread tree in the original languages.
Dotted idOutputAn entry's position in its thread: 12 is a top-level post, 12.3 a reply to it, 12.3.1 a reply to that.
PermalinkOutputA link that opens the model page at Reviews & Ratings with one thread pinned at the top, using MakerWorld's replyId and replyType.
Reply gapOutputThe small shortfall between replies found and the site's reply count, caused by deleted replies the site still counts.
Vibe dashboardDeliverySwami's dark-theme single-page dashboard design; this skill can build one from the reviews JSON.
AskUserQuestionDeliveryThe Claude tool that shows clickable choices; used for the "Build a vibe-dashboard?" offer.
SendUserFileDeliveryThe Claude tool that delivers a file into the chat as a card.
